qualification.details: All full-time, part-time, and Open and Distance Learning (ODL) courses approved by AICTE and UGC are accepted, including Graduation and Post Graduation as specified. Qualifications must be from a UGC-recognized university, AICTE-approved institution, or the concerned statutory council. Diploma qualifications must be recognized by the respective State Board of Technical Education; ITI/ NAC qualifications must be recognized by SCTVT/ NCTVT. Post-qualification experience must be acquired after passing the respective course. Industrial/ Vocational/ Apprentice training under the Apprentices Act will not be counted as work experience. Candidates working in Government/ Public Sector must have a minimum of one year's experience in the next lower pay scale or equivalent.

salary_details.details: Selected candidates will be on probation for one year and will draw initial basic pay in the corresponding pay scale. In addition to Basic Pay, candidates are entitled to: | Industrial Dearness Allowance (IDA) at applicable rates Perquisites @ 35% of basic pay North-East allowance @ 10% of basic pay (if posted in the North-East region) HRA Conveyance Maintenance Expenses Reimbursement (CMER) Medical Facility Post Retirement Medical Scheme (PRMS) Defined Contribution Pension Scheme (DCPS) | These are admissible as per Company rules in force and as amended from time to time.

selection_process: Candidates meeting all eligibility criteria (as declared in the online Application Form) will be considered for further Selection Process. Depending on the number of eligible applicants
the process may involve a single stage or multiple stages. If the number of applications is very high
BCPL may raise the minimum eligibility standards to shortlist candidates. The Selection Process shall consist of Skill Test / Proficiency Test / Endurance Test / Written Test

and the exact process will be communicated in advance to shortlisted candidates. The selection process indicated is tentative and may vary depending on administrative/ business requirements or Government of India directives. Candidates must meet the prescribed medical fitness standards. Eye power criteria: for technical officers
total myopia should not exceed (-)4.00D and hypermetropia should not exceed (+)4.00D in each eye; for non-technical officers
myopia should not exceed (-)8.00D and hypermetropia should not exceed (+)6.00D (for candidates above 20 years). No travelling expenses are payable to candidates called for the written test.
how_to_apply: Applications must be submitted online only through the official BCPL website: www.bcplonline.co.in. No other mode of application will be accepted.
Candidates can apply for ONE post only. If a candidate submits more than one application, only the one submitted on the later date will be considered.

Before applying, candidates should keep the following ready: A valid e-mail ID (must remain active for at least one year; cannot be changed later) A recent passport-size photograph and signature in digital form (.jpg/ .jpeg, under 50 KB) Digital copies (.jpg/ .pdf, max 200 KB) of proof of age, SC/ ST/ EWS certificate, Benchmark Disability certificate (for PwBD), Ex-Servicemen certificate, mark sheets/ qualification certificates, and post-qualification experience certificates, as applicable.
A valid e-mail ID (must remain active for at least one year; cannot be changed later)
A recent passport-size photograph and signature in digital form (.jpg/ .jpeg, under 50 KB)

Digital copies (.jpg/ .pdf, max 200 KB) of proof of age, SC/ ST/ EWS certificate, Benchmark Disability certificate (for PwBD), Ex-Servicemen certificate, mark sheets/ qualification certificates, and post-qualification experience certificates, as applicable.
After submitting the application, candidates must download the system-generated Pay-in Slip and Registration Slip.
Candidates are not required to submit a hard copy of the application form to BCPL.

If shortlisted for the further Selection Process, candidates must carry the downloaded Application Form, original documents, and one self-attested photocopy set, including proof of date of birth, caste/ tribe certificate (if applicable), disability certificate (if applicable), ex-servicemen proof (if applicable), all qualification certificates from matriculation onward, and complete experience certificates as specified in the notification.

Candidates employed in Central/ State Government, PSEs, or Autonomous Bodies must forward their application through the proper channel or produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) at the time of the Selection Process.

faq.question: Q1. What is BCPL Non-Executive Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by Brahmaputra Cracker and Polymer Limited (BCPL), a Government of India Enterprise, under Advertisement No. BCPL-NE/06/2026, for Non-Executive posts including Foreman, Junior Superintendent, Operator, Technician, and Trainee positions.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in BCPL Non-Executive Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 21 regular vacancies (16 UR, 04 OBC, 01 SC) across 8 posts, plus 3 additional Trainee posts reserved for PwBD candidates - a total of 24 vacancies.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for BCPL Non-Executive Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of the online application form is 09.10.2026, 17:00 hours.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for BCPL Non-Executive Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Qualification varies by post - ranging from Matric plus ITI/NAC trade certificates (Technician posts) to Diploma in Engineering (Foreman posts) to Bachelor's Degree with relevant specialization (Operator, Junior Superintendent, Accounts Assistant Trainee). See the eligibility tables above for post-wise details.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for BCPL Non-Executive Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 32 years for Foreman and Junior Superintendent (HR) posts, and 30 years for Operator, Technician, and Trainee posts, as on the cut-off date of 09.10.2026, with applicable relaxations for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for BCPL Non-Executive Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Rs. 200/- (non-refundable) for General, EWS, and OBC (NCL) candidates. SC/ST and PwBD candidates are exempted from the application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for BCPL Non-Executive Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply online only through www.bcplonline.co.in. No other mode of application is accepted, and each candidate can apply for only one post.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for BCPL Non-Executive Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process consists of Skill Test / Proficiency Test / Endurance Test / Written Test, as applicable, and is subject to change based on the number of applicants and Company/Government directives.
